description: Keyword search over sourced facts: each hit is a claim with the speaker's exact quote, timestamp, episode and links. Best for 'what did X say about Y' (search 'X Y', not the whole question). Results include show_slug and episode_slug for get_episode or get_transcript. Pages via offset/next_offset; total counts all matches; match says how strictly the keywords matched.

offset.description: How many to skip, default 0. Pass next_offset from the previous page to get the next page.

query.description: Keywords, matched literally (stemmed full-text search, not semantic). Best with 2-4 distinctive words such as names, companies or terms, e.g. "Jensen Huang data centers". Filler and question words are ignored; results matching every keyword come first, then results matching some of them.

show.description: Only search this show: slug or title from list_shows

name: search_facts
title: Search facts
